recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-27762; any retroactive R4/R4B publication correction should be handled separately as release-maintenance work.
issue_request: FHIR-27762 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocab change request for R5. It reported that CodeSystem csd-1 used `concept.code.combine($this.descendants().concept.code).isDistinct()`, where `$this.descendants()` did not correctly collect nested concept codes, and the accepted resolution was Bryn Rhodes' final expression: `concept.exists() implies concept.code.combine(%resource.concept.descendants().concept.code).isDistinct()`.
initial_application: Commit ade907ca5b1bc08efb093bc524c5b00bdc7fa5ac, `2nd batch of vocab R5 tickets`, explicitly listed FHIR-27762 and changed source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml from the old `$this.descendants()` expression to the final approved expression.
additional_context: CodeSystem is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini and remains Vocab-owned normative core source. Current source and release5 history contain the corrected expression; the old expression was found only in frozen tools/history/release4 and release4b artifacts. Confluence minutes confirm the 2021-07-08 Vocab approval vote, and the original community.fhir.org thread corroborates the `$this` problem. Corrected Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-27762 discussion or later superseding decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The authoritative current StructureDefinition already implements the Jira-approved CodeSystem csd-1 expression, and historical R4/R4B snapshot files do not drive the current build.
